text: The authors acknowledge that prior work, including Khan et al. [13], shows debate can help humans assess answers to reading comprehension questions, but note that these works mainly use multiple-choice questions about short science-fiction stories the judges have not read, a toy setting; they argue methods must now be proven in more realistic settings.
